description: Canonical schema for the Phase 3 Lead Funnel Conversion Observatory data package.

columns.name: record_id
columns.description: Stable unique identifier for the canonical record.

columns.name: record_type
columns.description: Type of record represented by the row.

columns.name: observed_at
columns.description: Observation date/time in ISO 8601 format.

columns.name: entity_id
columns.description: Primary entity identifier from the source.

columns.name: related_entity_id
columns.description: Identifier of a related entity when applicable.

columns.name: entity_name
columns.description: Human-readable entity name when available.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Standardized high-level category.

columns.name: subcategory
columns.description: Standardized lower-level category.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Current status of the record.

columns.name: stage
columns.description: Funnel or process stage.

columns.name: metric_name
columns.description: Name of the numeric or measurable attribute.

columns.name: metric_value
columns.description: Numeric value associated with metric_name.

columns.name: metric_unit
columns.description: Unit associated with metric_value.

columns.name: text_value
columns.description: Textual value when a source attribute is represented as text.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Latitude when geographic coordinates are available.

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Longitude when geographic coordinates are available.

columns.name: source_name
columns.description: Name of the source dataset.

columns.name: source_record_id
columns.description: Original source record identifier.

columns.name: is_synthetic
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is synthetic. Must be confirmed from source provenance.

columns.name: data_version
columns.description: Version identifier for the canonical data package.
